SELECT Id, Status, PartyType, Version, EntityType, EntitySubType, EntityTitle, EntityCreatedDate, IndividualFirstName, IndividualMiddleName, IndividualLastName, IndividualSuffix, IndividualDateOfBirth, IndividualCitizenship, IndividualMaritalStatus, Addresses, Contacts, Identifiers, CreatedDate, UpdatedDate, CreatedBy, UpdatedBy, IsDeleted, IsDeceased, DateOfDeath, TaxIdentifierType 
	FROM Party WHERE Id = '{{party_id}}';
